nodes.name: ArtistDiscographyPageViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel for the artist discography page, orchestrating async initialization and load of full discography data filtered by release type.

nodes.name: ArtistDiscographyPageViewModel
nodes.summary: Manages discography page state, exposes albums/singles/compilations collections, and coordinates async loading from artist data.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes the discography page with artist metadata and triggers async data load.

nodes.name: LoadAllAsync
nodes.summary: Asynchronously fetches and categorizes all release groups (albums, singles, compilations) for the artist.

nodes.name: ArtistsLibraryViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: Large ViewModel managing the Artists Library view with multi-mode display (saved/liked/discography), filtering, sorting, narrow layout, track panel, and breadcrumb navigation.

nodes.name: ArtistsLibraryViewModel
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the artists library: source switching, album selection, track panel, narrow/wide layout adaptation, sorting, and filtering across artist/album collections.

nodes.name: OnSourceModeChangedCore
nodes.summary: Handles transitions between Saved/Liked/Discography source modes, reloading the appropriate artist list.

nodes.name: LoadDataAsync
nodes.summary: Loads artist data for the current source mode, dispatching to saved or liked artist loaders.

nodes.name: LoadLikedArtistsAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches liked artists from the library and maps them to display items, applying current filter and sort.

nodes.name: OpenArtistDetails
nodes.summary: Navigates to the inline artist details panel for the selected artist, loading discography if needed.

nodes.name: OnSelectedArtistChanged
nodes.summary: Responds to artist selection changes, updating breadcrumbs and triggering detail load.

nodes.name: OnSaveStateChanged
nodes.summary: Reacts to library save-state changes (follow/unfollow), updating the artist list incrementally.

nodes.name: SortArtists
nodes.summary: Applies the current sort order to the saved artists collection.

nodes.name: PlayTrackAsync
nodes.summary: Initiates playback of a selected track within the artist context.

nodes.name: ArtistViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: Core ViewModel for the full artist page, coordinating hero images, spotlight projection, discography sections, music video catalog, theme derivation, and suspend/resume lifecycle.

nodes.name: ArtistViewModel
nodes.summary: Manages the complete artist page state: metadata loading, discography sections, music video prime, hero image resolution, theme application, and hibernate/resume for nav cache.

nodes.name: RaiseSpotlightProjection
nodes.summary: Builds and broadcasts the spotlight projection (hero image + color + artist name) for the page header.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Sets up the artist page from a navigation parameter, optionally prefilling from cached data.

nodes.name: Hibernate
nodes.summary: Suspends background work and releases heavy resources when the page is removed from the nav cache.

nodes.name: ApplyOverviewState
nodes.summary: Switches the visible content area between biography, discography, and related-artists overview panels.

nodes.name: LoadAsync
nodes.summary: Main async load pipeline: fetches artist metadata, biography, social links, and top tracks from SpClient/Pathfinder.

nodes.name: ApplySecondaryArtistSectionsAsync
nodes.summary: Loads and appends related artists, featured playlists, and appears-on sections after the primary load completes.

nodes.name: Dispose
nodes.summary: Disposes all reactive subscriptions and cancels in-flight async operations.

nodes.name: BrowseViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel for the Browse page, loading genre/mood categories as hero slides with derived color brushes and background imagery from the Pathfinder catalog API.

nodes.name: BrowseViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads top-level browse categories, derives hero slides and color brushes, and exposes them for the Browse page carousel and grid.

nodes.name: ReloadCoreAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches browse categories from Pathfinder, maps them to slide items and color data, and populates the display collections.

nodes.name: DeriveHeroSlides
nodes.summary: Converts raw category items into hero slide descriptors with image URLs and accent colors.

nodes.name: BuildHeaderBrush
nodes.summary: Constructs a gradient or solid brush from an extracted category accent color for the section header.

nodes.name: ConcertViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel and supporting data-holder records for the Concert detail page, loading event metadata, artists, offers, related events, and applying theme colors.

nodes.name: ConcertViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads concert event data from SpClient, maps artists/offers/related/playlists into typed sub-ViewModels, and applies a derived theme color.

nodes.name: ApplyTheme
nodes.summary: Extracts dominant color from the concert poster image and applies derived brushes for the page theme.

nodes.name: LoadAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches the full concert event payload and maps it into typed sub-ViewModels (artists, offers, related).

nodes.name: ConnectStateViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: Debug ViewModel for inspecting live Spotify Connect cluster state events, with filter/search over a scrolling event log.

nodes.name: ConnectStateViewModel
nodes.summary: Subscribes to raw dealer Connect events, maintains a bounded event log, and applies kind/search filters for the debug panel.

nodes.name: ConnectStateEventRow
nodes.summary: Data record representing a single Connect state event row with timestamp, kind, device name, and serialized payload.

nodes.name: OnSourceChanged
nodes.summary: Reacts to new Connect events from the dealer observable, appending and trimming the event log.

nodes.name: Rebuild
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the filtered event view from the full log by re-applying current kind and search filters.

nodes.name: ITrackListViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: Interface contract defining the surface shared by all track-list ViewModels: playback commands, selection, queue operations, and metadata bindings.

nodes.name: ITrackListViewModel
nodes.summary: Defines the common ViewModel contract for track lists across playlist, album, artist, and liked-songs views.

nodes.name: CreatePlaylistViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel for the Create Playlist dialog, validating the name field, creating the playlist via SpClient, and closing the current tab on success.

nodes.name: CreatePlaylistViewModel
nodes.summary: Handles user input validation and async playlist creation, then navigates away on completion.

nodes.name: CreateAsync
nodes.summary: Submits the playlist creation request to SpClient and handles success/error feedback.

nodes.name: DebugViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: Developer debug ViewModel providing a request workbench to send raw SpClient, Pathfinder GraphQL, and extended-metadata requests with live response formatting and hex dump output.

nodes.name: DebugViewModel
nodes.summary: Exposes a request builder for SpClient and Pathfinder calls, with preset management, protobuf decoding, JSON formatting, and hex dump rendering for developer diagnostics.

nodes.name: SendAsync
nodes.summary: Dispatches a raw SpClient HTTP request and formats the response body for display.

nodes.name: SendPathfinderAsync
nodes.summary: Executes a Pathfinder GraphQL operation and renders the JSON response in the debug panel.

nodes.name: FormatProtobufResponse
nodes.summary: Decodes a binary protobuf response body to human-readable text for the debug output pane.

nodes.name: DetailViewEnvelopes.cs
nodes.summary: Defines discriminated-union envelope records used to carry detail-view navigation payloads (album, artist, playlist, episode) through the nav stack.

nodes.name: EpisodePageViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel for the podcast episode detail page, managing playback state, chapter timeline, comment threads, progress tracking, and sibling episode navigation.

nodes.name: EpisodePageViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads and displays a podcast episode with playback controls, chapter seek, comment submission, progress tracking, and sibling navigation.

nodes.name: LoadAsync
nodes.summary: Fetches episode metadata, transcript, chapters, and sibling list; applies initial playback state.

nodes.name: RefreshChapterTimeline
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the chapter timeline items from the episode chapters list, marking the current active chapter.

nodes.name: Play
nodes.summary: Initiates or resumes playback of the episode at the given position, optionally seeking to a chapter.

nodes.name: SubmitCommentAsync
nodes.summary: Posts a new comment to the episode thread and prepends it to the local comment list optimistically.

nodes.name: Dispose
nodes.summary: Cancels active subscriptions and releases playback resources on page disposal.

nodes.name: FeedbackViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel for the in-app feedback wizard, handling multi-step form validation, screenshot attachment, diagnostic log assembly, and GitHub issue submission.

nodes.name: FeedbackViewModel
nodes.summary: Drives a multi-step feedback submission flow: category selection, details entry with screenshot attachments, and automated GitHub issue creation with diagnostics.

nodes.name: ValidateDetailsStep
nodes.summary: Validates the details step fields (title, description, repro steps) and surfaces per-field errors.

nodes.name: TryAddImage
nodes.summary: Opens a file picker and appends the selected screenshot to the attachment list after size/format validation.

nodes.name: SubmitAsync
nodes.summary: Serializes the feedback form, uploads attachments, and creates a GitHub issue via API.

nodes.name: BuildDiagnosticsLog
nodes.summary: Collects runtime diagnostics (OS, app version, settings snapshot) into a formatted string for the issue body.

nodes.name: FriendFeedRowViewModel.cs
nodes.summary: ViewModel row for a single friend-feed entry, mapping Spotify friend activity to displayable metadata and providing navigation commands to artist/track/context.

nodes.name: FriendFeedRowViewModel
nodes.summary: Represents one friend activity row with avatar, friend name, track/artist/context metadata, and navigation command bindings.

nodes.name: FriendFeedRowViewModel
nodes.summary: Constructor mapping raw friend activity data to display properties and nav commands.

nodes.name: NavigateToContext
nodes.summary: Navigates to the playlist/album/show context the friend was listening within.
